abstract: The benign hydatidiform mole (partial and complete) practically represents an associated pathology of the first trimester miscarriage; it is considered that it represents the initial pathology, which, evolutionally, may be followed by the appearance of invasive mole and choriocarcinoma. The authors have studied clinical and cytogenetical 61 cases selected according to some specific criteria for the suspicion of molar pregnancy or hydropic abortion and 21 cases that represented the control group made by patients with normal pregnancy which have been presented for legal abortion. In all cases has been made a histological exam and has been studied the vasculogenesis by immunohistochemistry labeling for CD31 and CD34. Following-up the results has been established a number of histological and immunohistochemical criteria for the evaluation and differentiation of various molar pregnancy types and the vasculogenesis characteristics. The most important differential diagnosis criteria between partial and complete mole is represented by the trophoblast disposition and the atypical trophoblast in the complete mole.
abstract_ja: 良性胞状奇胎（部分性および完全性）は、基本的には妊娠初期流産に伴う病変であり、その後、侵入奇胎や絨毛癌へと進展しうる初期病変と考えられている。著者らは、胞状奇胎または水腫性流産を疑う特定の基準に基づいて選択された61例の臨床および細胞遺伝学的解析と、正常妊娠で人工妊娠中絶を受けた21例の対照群を検討した。全例で組織学的検査を行い、CD31およびCD34に対する免疫組織化学染色により脈管形成を調べた。結果を検討し、各種胞状奇胎型と脈管形成の特徴を評価・鑑別するための組織学的および免疫組織化学的基準を定めた。部分胞状奇胎と完全胞状奇胎を鑑別する最も重要な鑑別診断の基準は、栄養膜の配置と、完全奇胎における異型栄養膜である。
